verdict.rationale: Railway documents a built-in, chat-based Railway Agent in the dashboard. It inspects the user's deployments, diagnoses failures and proposes code fixes as pull requests, which delivers AI-generated insights and suggestions from the user's own project data inside the product. Missing for 10: proactive or unprompted insights (e.g., automatic analysis of metrics or cost data), and independent or hands-on corroboration of diagnosis quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The Railway Agent is a chat-based AI assistant built into the Railway dashboard. It can operate the platform on your behalf: creating and configuring services, inspecting deployments, diagnosing failures, and opening pull requests to fix broken builds.
If the fix is in your code, the agent can open a pull request with the change so you can review and merge it.
Mention @Railway in Slack to ask the Railway Agent about your projects, inspect deployments, read logs, and make changes without leaving the conversation.
